Mohan Lal Grero Foundation 4: (Incorporation) Act, No. 20 of 2014

4.
The objects of the Corporation shall be carried out in
such  manner  so  as  not  to  create  any  conflict  between  the
work  of  the  Corporation  and  any  work  being  carried  out
simultaneously  by  any  Ministry  or  Department  of  the
Government or of any Provincial Council.
(1)  Subject  to  the  provisions  of  this  Act  the
management  and  administration  of  the  affairs  of  the
Corporation  shall  be  carried  out  by  a  Board  of  Directors
(hereinafter  referred  to  as  the  “Board”)  consisting  of  such
number  of  office  bearers  as  may  be  specified  by  the  rules
made under section 7.
(2) (a) The Board of the Foundation that holds office on
the day immediately preceding the date of commencement
of this Act, shall function as the Board of the Corporation
until  the  first  Board  is  appointed  or  elected  in  the  manner
provided for by rules made under section 7.
(b)  The first Board of the Corporation shall be appointed
or elected within one year of the date of commencement of
this Act.
(3)  (a)  Every  office  bearer  of  the  Board  including  the
patrons and advisers, shall be appointed or elected for a period
of three years and any such office bearer, patron or advisor
shall be eligible for re-appointment or re-election after lapse
of the said period of three years.
(b) In the event of a vacancy occurring due to the death,
resignation, incapacity or removal from office of an office
bearer,  the  Board  shall  having  regard  to  the  rules  of  the
Corporation, elect or appoint a person to fill such vacancy.
(c) The person elected or appointed under paragraph (b)
shall hold office only for the unexpired portion of the term of
office of the member whom he succeeds.
